Thanks for the good demo earlier — appreciate you and Marco carving out time. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we can keep procurement moving: 

1) Controller/Processor alignment
- We need confirmation of roles for the Fintrax integration. From our side Redwood typically signs as Processor when customers are Controllers; want to confirm whether Fintrax will be Controller for the involved data flows.

2) SCC module preference
- To comply with EU transfers, we support both the Standard SCC set and a modular SCC with a processor annex. Please let us know which flavour your legal team prefers (standard vs modular with annex).

3) SOC 2 status & evidence
- Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II; we can share the auditor report under NDA. Is there a preferred timeline for evidence review with your security team?

4) Vendor security questionnaire (VSA)
- Attached is our short vendor questionnaire (Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf). Can you confirm procurement’s lead and a target date to complete? We typically ask for a two-week turnaround for initial answers.

Next steps we propose:
- Fintrax confirms controller/processor stance and SCC module preference (action: Fintrax legal)
- Procurement contact confirms timeline for questionnaire (action: Fintrax procurement)
- Redwood to prepare DPA draft for the selected SCC flavour and share SOC 2 evidence under NDA (action: Redwood)

Feel free to reply-all with any clarifying questions. If useful, we can also schedule a quick 20m technical evidence call with our security engineer to walk through the SOC 2 scope.

Thanks,
